questions.question: Who has been appointed the 52nd Chief Justice of India after the retirement of CJI Sanjiv Khanna?
questions.solution:

__

__
 
• **Justice B R Gavai is currently the senior judge in the Supreme Court.**
 
• **He was elevated to the Supreme Court on May 24, 2019.**
 
• **He will take charge after CJI Khanna retires on May 13, 2025.**
 
• **He will remain in office until November 23, 2025.**

 __

• Was a part of key rulings including demonetisation, abrogation of Article 370, and Electoral Bonds judgement.
 
• Advocated for applying the creamy layer principle to SCs/STs for real equality.
 
 
 
• **Justice Sanjay Kishan Kaul**__
 __
 
• Recently retired from the Supreme Court in December 2023.
 
 
 
• **Justice D Y Chandrachud**__
 __
 
• Served as the 50th Chief Justice of India.
 
 
 
• **Justice S Abdul Nazeer**__
 
 
• Known for his role in the Ayodhya verdict, retired in 2023.

questions.question: Which institution has been recently authorized to exchange information with the Enforcement Directorate under the PMLA to combat cyber fraud?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) has been authorized to exchange information with the Enforcement Directorate under the PMLA to tackle cyber frauds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **I4C is now authorized to share and receive information from the Enforcement Directorate to trace money trails and combat cyber frauds.**
 
• This move aims to identify the masterminds behind transnational cybercrimes, often executed through deceptive online methods.
 
• The collaboration is made under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), enhancing India's capability to tackle cybercrime.
 
• I4C focuses on improving coordination among various law enforcement agencies and stakeholders to curb cybercrime in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• PMLA (Prevention of Money Laundering Act)__

 __
 
• Indian legislation aimed at preventing money laundering and punishing offenders involved in the same.
 
• It empowers various agencies, including the Enforcement Directorate, to investigate and prosecute money laundering cases.
 
 
 
• Enforcement Directorate (ED)__
 __
 
• Indian government agency responsible for enforcing economic laws and fighting financial crime, including money laundering.
 
 
 
• Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C)__
 __
 
• Established under the Home Ministry to act as the central agency coordinating efforts to combat cybercrime in India.
 
 
 
• National Cybercrime Reporting Portal__
 
 
• An online platform where citizens can report cybercrimes, such as frauds and scams.
 
• It helps law enforcement agencies track and investigate cybercrimes in India.

questions.question: Which team won the 2024-25 Vijay Hazare Trophy ?

• The team's success in the tournament was attributed to **consistent performances from both batsmen and bowlers**, showcasing their dominance in Indian domestic cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Named after the legendary Indian cricketer Vijay Hazare, the tournament was first introduced in the 2002-03 season.
 
• It is a 50-over format competition and serves as a platform for domestic players to showcase their skills for potential selection in the national team.
 
• The tournament features teams representing Indian states, as well as other cricket associations affiliated with the BCCI.
 
 
 
• **Karnataka's Cricket Legacy:**

• **Key Players in Vijay Hazare Trophy 2024-25:**

• **Domestic Cricket in India:**

• These tournaments play a crucial role in identifying and nurturing talent for the Indian national cricket team.

questions.question: As per the National Family Health Survey NFHS-4, what is the total fertility rate of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2.2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Total Fertility Rate (TFR)** of India as per the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-4) conducted in 2015-16 is **2.2 children per woman**.
 
• A TFR of 2.2 indicates that India is approaching the **replacement-level fertility**, which is 2.1 (the level at which a population exactly replaces itself from one generation to the next).
 
• India's TFR has been steadily declining due to improved **family planning measures**, increased female literacy, and better healthcare access.
 
• States such as Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Madhya Pradesh had higher TFRs during the survey, while states like Kerala and Tamil Nadu recorded much lower TFRs, demonstrating significant regional variation.
 
• The National Family Health Survey is conducted by the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare** (MoHFW) in collaboration with the International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Total Fertility Rate (TFR):**

 
 
• TFR refers to the average number of children a woman would have during her lifetime, based on the current age-specific fertility rates.
 
• A TFR of 2.1 is considered the **replacement level**, where the population remains stable without immigration.
 
• Lower TFRs indicate controlled population growth, which is often linked to better socioeconomic indicators.
 
 
 
• **National Family Health Survey (NFHS):**
 
 
• NFHS is a large-scale, multi-round survey conducted in a representative sample of households across India.
 
• The survey provides essential data on health, family welfare, and other vital issues like fertility, mortality, and nutrition.
 
• NFHS-4 was conducted in 2015-16 and covered all 29 states and 7 union territories.
 
 
 
• **Factors Influencing TFR:**
 
 
• Key factors include women's education, access to healthcare, family planning services, and economic development.
 
• Government initiatives like **Mission Parivar Vikas** aim to reduce TFR in high-fertility districts.
 
 
 
• **Global Perspective:**
 
 
• Globally, TFR varies significantly, with developed countries often having TFRs below replacement levels, while many developing countries still have higher TFRs.
 
• India's declining TFR aligns it with global trends of population stabilization.

questions.question: The "Biomass Satellite Mission", recently seen in the news, is a project of which of the following organizations?
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 2. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The European Space Agency (ESA) recently launched the Biomass Satellite Mission to accurately map the world’s forests and study their role in the global carbon cycle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Biomass Satellite is an ESA mission designed to provide detailed 3D maps of the world's tropical forests. **Hence, option 2 is correct. **
 
• It uses a unique **P-band radar** that penetrates deep into the forest canopy to measure tree trunks, branches, and stems — the major carbon stores.
 
• The mission will help better understand carbon storage and fluxes, crucial for studying climate change.
 
• The satellite was launched aboard a **Vega C rocket** from Europe’s Spaceport in French Guiana.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Biomass Satellite is placed in a **Sun-synchronous orbit** (SSO) at an altitude of about 666 km.
 
• It is the first satellite ever to carry a **P-band synthetic aperture radar** specifically for biomass measurement.

questions.question: Which Indian Naval Ship (INS) provided urgent medical assistance to a Pakistani crew member aboard a fishing vessel in the Central Arabian Sea in April 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**INS Trikand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On 4th April 2025, Indian Navy's stealth frigate INS Trikand** provided critical medical assistance to a severely injured Pakistani crew member in the Central Arabian Sea, approximately 350 nautical miles east of the Oman coast.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• INS Trikand intercepted a distress call from Iranian dhow **Al Omeedi** regarding a crew member transferred to FV Abdul Rehman Hanzia.
 
• The injured Pakistani (Baloch) national had suffered multiple hand fractures and severe blood loss.
 
• INS Trikand’s Medical Officer and MARCOS team conducted a 3-hour surgical procedure onboard the vessel.
 
• The intervention prevented permanent damage and provided follow-up medical supplies including antibiotics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• INS Trikand__

 __
 
• Stealth frigate of the Indian Navy, part of the Talwar-class.
 
• Equipped for maritime surveillance, humanitarian assistance, and combat roles.
 
 
 
• MARCOS (Marine Commandos)__
 __
 
• Special operations unit of the Indian Navy.
 
• Deployed with medical and boarding teams for critical missions.
 
 
 
• Humanitarian Assistance at Sea__
 
 
• INS Trikand's response aligns with India’s commitment to maritime cooperation and humanitarian aid.
 
• The Pakistani and Iranian crew expressed deep gratitude for the life-saving intervention.

questions.question: Name the IMF report that analyzes the impact of artificial intelligence on electricity demand, prices, and carbon emissions.

options.text: The AI Transition and Global Labor Markets
Green Tech and the Global Energy Shift
Power Hungry: How AI Will Drive Energy Demand
Digital Futures: AI and Sustainable Growth

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Power Hungry: How AI Will Drive Energy Demand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The IMF released the report titled "Power Hungry: How AI Will Drive Energy Demand" on April 22, 2025, examining the effects of AI on global electricity usage and emissions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **AI sectors in the U.S. grew nearly three times faster than other private non-farm sectors.**
 
• Electricity costs for integrated AI firms nearly doubled between 2019–2023.
 
• Electricity prices in the U.S. could increase by 8.6% by 2030 under constrained green infrastructure growth.
 
• The report recommends policy alignment between AI growth and energy infrastructure to manage environmental impact.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **IMF-ENV Model**__

 __
 
• Multi-country Computable General Equilibrium model used in the study.
 
• Simulates impacts of AI on energy consumption and carbon emissions globally.
 
• Estimates global carbon emissions could rise by 1.2% by 2030 under current policy settings.
 
 
 
• **Challenges Identified**__
 
 
• Limited growth in renewable energy and transmission capacity could worsen electricity prices.
 
• Need for environmentally conscious energy planning amid AI-driven tech growth.
 
• Highlights increasing energy intensity of large AI models like ChatGPT.
